library(ggplot2)

```{r}
# example from Vector Feild interpolation with RFB paper
VF_1 = function(v) c(v[1]*(1/2*v[1]^2+1/2)+v[2]*(-v[1]+(1/2*v[2]-1)*v[2]+1/2),1/2*v[1]^2*v[2]+v[1]*(-1/2*v[2]^2+v[2]-1/2)+1/2*v[2]-1) 

VF_StableCycle=function(v) c(v[2],-v[1])
```

## numerical integrators
```{r}
forward_euler=function(x0, fun, step_size, n){

  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  for(i in 2:n){
    path[[i]]=path[[i-1]]+step_size*fun(path[[i-1]])
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
  }
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
}
```

```{r}
bridge=function(x0,xT,T, fun, step_size,k){

  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  n=T/step_size
  for(i in 2:n){
    path[[i]]=path[[i-1]]+step_size*(fun(path[[i-1]])+k*(((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-i*step_size)))
    #path[[i]]=path[[i-1]]+step_size*((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-i*step_size)
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
  }
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x[1:n-1],
    y=y[1:n-1]
  )
  return(path_df)
}
```

```{r}
euler_maryama_bridge=function(x0,xT,T, fun, Q, step_size){
  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  n=T/step_size
  times <- seq(0, T, by=step_size)
  
  for(i in 2:length(times)){
    #temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*(fun(path[[i-1]])+k*(((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-i*step_size)))
    temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*(fun(path[[i-1]])+(((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-times[i])))

    #temp=path[[i-1]]+step_size*((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-i*step_size)

    
    #we need to construct a joint normal distribution and and sample form that if     #the X and y components are not independent
    
    #if they are independent then this works
    suppressWarnings({
      temp_x=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[1,1]*step_size)
      temp_y=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[2,2]*step_size)
    })
    temp_x=temp_x+temp[1]
    temp_y=temp_y+temp[2]
    path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
    }
  
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x[1:n-1],
    y=y[1:n-1]
  )
  return(path_df)
  }

```

```{r}
fun=function(s,T,F){
  expm::expm(F*(T-s))
}
```

```{r}
monte_carlo_integration=function(fun,a,b,n,F,beta){
  t=runif(n,min=a,max=b)
  result=0
  for(i in 1:n){
    result=result+fun(s=t[i],T=b,F=F)%*%beta
  }
  return(((b-a)/n)*result)
}
```

#linearization Guided Bridge

```{r}
x0=c(data$x[1],data$y[1])
xT=c(data$x[2],data$y[2])
F=pracma::jacobian(VF_1,x0)
beta=VF_1(x0)-F%*%x0
Q=array(c(.5,0,0,.5), dim=c(2,2))



m <- function(s, T, x, F, beta) {

  Phi <- expm::expm(F * (T-s))

  Phi %*% x +
    solve(F, (Phi - diag(nrow(F))) %*% beta)
}

```

```{r}

p=function(t,n){
  T=data$t[2]
  s=t
  
   fun_p=function(s,T){
    expm::expm(F*(T-s))%*%Q%*%t(Q)%*%t(expm::expm(F*(T-s)))
  }
  
  times=runif(n,min=s,max=T)
  result <- matrix(0, nrow=2, ncol=2)
  for(i in 1:n){
    result=result+fun_p(s=times[i],T=T)
  }
  return(((T-s)/n)*result)
}
```

```{r}
grad_log_p=function(s,x,T,v){
  #expm::expm(t(F)*(T-s))%*%ginv(p(s,1000))%*%(v-m(s,T,x,F,beta)
  expm::expm(t(F)*(T-s))%*%solve(p(s,1000), v-m(s,T,x,F,beta))
}
```


```{r}
euler_maryama_bridge_2=function(x0,xT,T, fun, Q, step_size){
  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  times <- seq(0, T, by=step_size)
  
  for(i in 2:length(times)){
    
    #temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*(fun(path[[i-1]])+k*(((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-i*step_size)))
    temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*(fun(path[[i-1]])+1000*(Q%*%t(Q)%*%grad_log_p(s = times[i],x = path[[i-1]],T = T,v = xT)))
    #temp=path[[i-1]]+step_size*((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-i*step_size)
    
    #we need to construct a joint normal distribution and and sample form that if     #the X and y components are not independent
    
    #if they are independent then this works
    # suppressWarnings({
    #   temp_x=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[1,1]*step_size)
    #   temp_y=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[2,2]*step_size)
    # })
    # temp_x=temp_x+temp[1]
    # temp_y=temp_y+temp[2]
    # path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
    noise <- Q %*% rnorm(2) * sqrt(step_size)
    path[[i]] <- temp + noise
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
    }
  
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x[1:length(times)],
    y=y[1:length(times)]
  )
  return(path_df)
  }
```

```{r}
euler_maryama_bridge_3=function(x0,xT,T, fun, Q, step_size){
  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  times <- seq(0, T, by=step_size)
  
  for(i in 2:length(times)){
    temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*(((-times[i]/T)+1)*fun(path[[i-1]])+(((xT-path[[i-1]]))/((T+.0000001)-times[i])))
    #temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*(fun(path[[i-1]])+1000*(Q%*%t(Q)%*%grad_log_p(s = times[i],x = path[[i-1]],T = T,v = xT)))
    #temp=path[[i-1]]+step_size*((xT-path[[i-1]]))/(T-i*step_size)
    
    #we need to construct a joint normal distribution and and sample form that if     #the X and y components are not independent
    
    #if they are independent then this works
    suppressWarnings({
      temp_x=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[1,1]*step_size)
      temp_y=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[2,2]*step_size)
    })
    temp_x=temp_x+temp[1]
    temp_y=temp_y+temp[2]
    path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
    #noise <- Q %*% rnorm(2) * sqrt(step_size)
    #path[[i]] <- temp + noise
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
    }
  
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x[1:length(times)],
    y=y[1:length(times)]
  )
  return(path_df)
  }
```
